entries.subject: Rizos et al. (2024), A&A 689, A82
entries.finding: Smooth ellipsoid fitted to stellar-occultation chords and rotational light curves: semiaxes 127 ± 5, 55 ± 4 and 45 ± 4 km.

entries.subject: Fernández-Valenzuela et al. (2017), assessed by the 2024 study
entries.finding: Prograde ecliptic pole, supported over 22 years; the refined photometric period is 9.1736 ± 0.0002 h.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The grid marks an unmapped surface. The smooth ellipsoid resolves no terrain or mapped albedo and leaves light-curve asymmetry unexplained; shape, albedo and companion alternatives remain unresolved. - Display longitude and absolute phase are arbitrary. Orbit context is fixed at 2026-09-03 TT. - Settings is hidden; optional Shadows were checked through the checkbox event. These reports do not establish a full-suite pass or physical-device performance.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Reference ellipsoid and light-curve asymmetry
entries.finding: The reference ellipsoid does not reproduce all observed light-curve asymmetry. The paper’s irregular-shape, contact-binary, albedo and satellite scenarios are alternatives rather than uniquely measured geometry. No ring or satellite is displayed because the selected occultations do not establish their geometry. Integrated light curves and spectra are not surface maps.
entries.revisitWhen: Published model-specific definitions, an independently constrained pole/scale, or a released replacement mesh that resolves the recorded ambiguity.

entries.subject: Complementary source survey
entries.finding: [The source survey](https://github.com/layoutit/cssEarth/blob/cc01831f595e0b73ab6699d6235cf7b466f76cfc/docs/centaur-population/README.md#source-survey-dispositions) records the selections and alternatives. Published papers are cited, not relicensed or bundled. Credits and reuse terms for the authored approximation, ESO panorama, Inter font and HYG metadata are in NOTICE.md and the manifest.
